decisions.statement: Every page in the folder is of a page type handed in or extending one.
Which page types those are is handed in rather than worked out here.
Every page names what holds them as holding it.
What holds them is handed in rather than worked out here.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside one is refused.
A file beside no page in this folder is refused.
A folder holding no page at all is refused.
Nothing here reads the page above the folder.
Nothing here reads the name of the folder it judges.

definition: how a folder of a collection's parts is judged, whatever those parts name as holding them
